title: CEnt: An Entropy-based Model-agnostic Explainability Framework to Contrast Classifiers’ Decisions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and performance evaluation of an explainability framework (CEnt) using metrics like proximity and flip rate. While it mentions ethical considerations as motivation and includes one example involving labels like 'atheism' and 'christian' in a text classification context, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary research component.
